summary: Story-level autoreview (codex, branch diff vs fd79887) of the FORGE-WIN-3 psutil port ran clean-room in a scratch worktree (evidence ledgers and the deliberate fake-AWS test fixture excluded; FORGE_PROCESS_TOKEN redacted in-bundle for the secret detector — shipped code unchanged). Four findings; three verified real and fixed in lite window Q-0061-61a1 (portable SIGKILL constant for the nt reap path, preexec_fn signal-mask unblock restored on POSIX spawns, legacy ps-lstart pid_started rows now fail closed in reconcile instead of reaping a live writer). The fourth (environ-unreadable fallback on macOS) was verified NOT a regression — the pre-psutil /proc and ps-eww paths also skipped unreadable environs by design. Two earlier stage-level runs surfaced the doctor --fix user-site convergence bug (fixed + lesson ledgered) plus two confirmed review-target artifacts.

non_blocking_findings.summary: bare signal.SIGKILL crashed the nt reap path — FIXED: module constant SIGKILL = getattr(signal,'SIGKILL',None)
POSIX children inherited the blocked SIGTERM/SIGINT mask after preexec_fn was dropped — FIXED: restored in the POSIX spawn branch only
reconcile reaped a live pre-upgrade writer whose pid_started was ps-lstart format — FIXED: non-float identity fails closed
doctor --fix psutil re-import false-failed same-run after a fresh user-scope install — FIXED: site.addsitedir + invalidate_caches; lesson ledgered

residual_risks: windows-hook-gates on PR #100 is the only real-Windows execution of the launch/reap path; pr_ready waits for it (WIN-2 lesson)
macOS environ() visibility limits the detached-worker token sweep to what the pre-psutil ps-eww path could also see — parity, not regression; children(recursive=True) remains the primary reap
recommendation: ship once windows-hook-gates is green on PR #100
